title: Drag-in Google Photos Takeout repair (JSON sidecar → EXIF, dedupe, rename)
user: People leaving Google Photos who need a clean chronological library without installing Python or uploading private photos.
smallest_useful_product: Select extracted Takeout folders or ZIP files, match Google JSON sidecars, preview results, repair JPEG and PNG metadata locally, deduplicate exact copies, optionally rename, and export a clean folder or ZIP.
constraints: Folder read/write uses Chromium's File System Access API; other browsers use ZIP import/export.
HEIC and video container metadata is reported but not rewritten in v1.
Large libraries must be processed incrementally to limit memory use.
No photo bytes leave the device.
monetization: Free for up to 20,000 input files with an optional one-time large-library license through Sociobot billing.
